description:
• Are you one of those unique individuals who understands both DESIGN and TECHNICAL aspects of creating great websites? Our branding and design studio is looking for a hands-on Web Developer with strong visual/design sense to help us create UNIQUE & CUSTOM websites for our clients

 • Bachelor’s degree, and 3+ years as a designer/developer
 • Assistance with sitemapping/wireframing
 • Excellent verbal communication
 • Create custom websites start to finish (expert in HTML, JS, CSS, jQuery, Javascript, WordPress, HTML emails, etc.)
 • Understanding of cross platform and cross browser compatibility issues (including mobile) and basic understanding of SEO and analytics
 • Assistance in Setting up domain/hosting and email if needed.
 • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
 • Custom WordPress theme creation
 • Responsive design/code
 • Ability to work with flexibility, efficiency and enthusiasm
 • Up to speed on the latest in web and digital technology
 • Accomplished in both web and print design preferred
 • Ability to communicate the value of what’s created 
 *We are open to work on Corp2Corp and OPT EAD

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
